# SEMESTA ISLAM

> Trusted Islamic learning ecosystem connecting learners & families with verified educators (sanad-backed).

## About

SEMESTA ISLAM is a digital platform that connects learners and families with qualified Islamic educators
(ustadz/ustadzah) and institutions whose credentials, sanad, and scholarly lineage have been verified by
the Lajnah verification board. Built on Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and Supabase.

## Key Public Pages

- [Home](https://semesta-islam.vercel.app/): Landing page with impact stats and verified educator showcase.
- [Directory](https://semesta-islam.vercel.app/directory): Browse verified educators by subject, location, and method.
- [Educator Profile](https://semesta-islam.vercel.app/educator/[id]): Public educator profile with sanad & credentials.
- [Booking](https://semesta-islam.vercel.app/booking): Request a learning session.
- [Discovery](https://semesta-islam.vercel.app/discovery): Explore learning journeys.
- [Contributions](https://semesta-islam.vercel.app/contributions): Social impact transparency.
- [Changelog](https://semesta-islam.vercel.app/changelog): Product updates.
- [Developer Portal](https://semesta-islam.vercel.app/developer): API & platform docs.

## Technology Stack

- Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5.7
- Tailwind CSS 3.4
- PostgreSQL 16 + Prisma 6 ORM
- Supabase (Auth + Postgres)
- Vitest test suite (111 tests)

## Data Model Highlights

- Users, profiles, and role assignments (LEARNER / EDUCATOR / LAJNAH_VERIFIER / FOUNDER_ADMIN)
- Educator profiles with verification status (4-layer Lajnah verification)
- Sanad records and credential badges
- Course catalogs, schedules, and booking requests
- Internal economy: economic transactions + ledger, XP ledger, reputation profiles, commissions
- Referral program, organizations, delegations, audit logs

## Documentation

Full governance docs (BRD, PRD, ERD, OSS, security) live in the GitHub repository
[univdin/semesta-islam](https://github.com/univdin/semesta-islam).
